scientific_integrity: All universal conclusions are derived analytically. Finite rational arithmetic is supplementary, not a substitute for proof; no external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact codimension-three resonance with left trace and determinant zero, right trace zero and determinant one; the formula is not a perturbation-stability assertion. Physical measure is relative to ambient planar Lebesgue measure, not normalized square area. Older polygon literature could contain an unindexed overlapping statement.
title: A fourth-iterate projection law and a physical-measure bifurcation in a border-collision map
